about: What NAIP (0.6 m) shows and does not show at HWD: tie-down marks, tie-down rings, hangar doors. Visual inspection of native-resolution crops (every 0.6 m pixel enlarged with nearest-neighbour, north up), 2024 and 2022.
made_by: task G2 agent, 2026-11-12: hwd3d/tools/imagery/naip_crop.py --name <area> --utm <E>,<N> --size <m> --up <k> [--year 2022] (outputs in hwd3d/out/phase1/crop_<year>_<area>.png, gitignored); row-aligned views of one West T-hangar row (bilinear, 0.15 m)
status: obs = seen in the pixels by eye; names in 'nearest_al5015_label' are inferred from the layout of FAA AL-5015 (the diagram is not georeferenced here), not verified
coords: crop centre in UTM 10N (EPSG:26910, NAD83) and in the hwd3d world frame (hwd_frame.py: x east, z south, m from the ARP)

areas.area: large apron north of RWY 10L/28R, about 400 m east of the 10L end
areas.tiedown_T_marks: VISIBLE, crisp in both years: painted white T marks (about 3 m) in straight rows parallel to faded yellow taxilane lines that run parallel to the runways; occupied T's differ between 2022 and 2024, so the two epochs together expose more empty T's
areas.other: about 45 light aircraft parked in 2024; a painted circle with 'H' and a row of curved markings at the north edge of the apron (helipads? not verified)

areas.area: tie-down apron between the West Hangars T-hangar rows
areas.tiedown_T_marks: visible but FAINT: worn light T / cross marks and faded yellow taxilane lines; locatable where not under an aircraft, low contrast

areas.area: taxilane row between FBO buildings north-east of the tower
areas.tiedown_T_marks: visible: short light marks beside each parked aircraft along the taxilane, plus tyre marks

areas.area: apron north-east, near the airport road
areas.tiedown_T_marks: not distinguishable; yellow painted curved lead-in / parking lines and a painted circle are visible; aircraft parked in a line along the fence

areas.area: ramp north of the 28R end (FBO buildings)
areas.tiedown_T_marks: not distinguishable in the crop; about 12 light aircraft parked wing to wing

areas.area: ramp south of RWY 10R/28L at the large box hangar
areas.tiedown_T_marks: none visible; a yellow taxilane line; business jets and singles parked

areas.area: paved area south-west of that hangar
areas.tiedown_T_marks: none; only scattered short white dashes (car-park style?) - purpose not identified

areas.hangar_doors: NOT VISIBLE: the door faces are vertical and the roofs are uniform white (a ridge line along the roof in 2024); no door rhythm on the roof edge or on the pavement in front, in either year
areas.other: roof outlines sharp; rows run at about 150/330 deg true; 2024 has a dark shadow band along one long side of each row (2022: barely any)

areas.hangar_doors: NOT VISIBLE (same as the West Hangars); a few vehicles parked in front of the rows

conclusion: At 0.6 m NAIP resolves painted tie-down T marks (well on the large ramp north of 10L/28R, faintly elsewhere) and taxilane lines, so tie-down spots can be digitised from NAIP as src 'obs' where a mark is seen and 'inf' where only an aircraft or a row pattern is seen (PLAN D3). Tie-down rings, chains and ropes are not resolved. Hangar doors (T-hangar bays, box-hangar doors) are not visible; door rhythm needs another source (OSM building parts, photos, or the owner's screenshots, Q4).
